comments.author: biggdogg420
comments.body:
Do you mean changing code, making art, or editing levels? Godot and Blender are free tools, but they do not include an unlimited AI coding service. For an existing game, you also need its source or supported modding tools.

If you want a free starting game to change, we maintain Star Circuit, a Three.js space-combat/racing prototype: https://games.free4allhub.com/star-circuit

The AI handoff explains how to assemble its editable source from the v2 base and v3 kit, with MIT/Apache-2.0 notices retained. You can use an editor and AI you already have; we do not provide AI credits. A small first remix could make boost spend shield. What change are you trying to make?
